What's the problem? (What's the problem? (Page 22)) Ethan stretched out his hand to push away the forelimb that was poking at his forehead, "Sir, if you poke me in the head again, a hole will be made." The energy-devouring insect retracted its forelimbs and lay down heavily in his hair. Six wings were stacked on the carapace, the two forelimbs were stacked together, and the mouthparts were tightly closed. After a while, it finally spoke, with a muffled voice, "That old man of blood and bones. What the hell is going on." Ethan just pretended not to hear this. He asked his dean, what the hell was a third-class apprentice doing? Even though there were only two of them around at the moment, the apprentices of Biying Academy stayed far away from the area. Ethan stopped and said, "Sir, where is the teleportation array? I want to go back." The energy-devouring insect flew up from above his head, its six wings vibrating. He drifted to the left, "This way, follow." The stone road stretched under the feet, and the trees on both sides became sparse. After walking for about two and a half hours, a circular square appeared in front of him. The rune array in the center of the square was exactly the same as when he came. Twelve stone pillars formed a circle, and the vine leaves on the pillars glowed with emerald green in the sun. "Here they are." The energy-devouring insect appeared above him. Flying up, one forelimb pointed toward the center of the array, "Just stand up and report your destination. This teleportation array connects the entire area 77. As long as you have the coordinates, you can go anywhere." Ethan stepped on the stone slab in the center of the array. The rune patterns under his feet lit up from the edge to the center, and emerald green light flowed in the lines. The pale golden light balls on the top of the twelve stone pillars glowed at the same time, in the center of the array. A huge network of light formed above. "Destination, Blood Bone Tower Academy." A second later, an ethereal voice sounded: "The destination has been confirmed, and the teleportation application has been sent." After another second, "The teleportation application has been approved. Can it be teleported? Do you want to teleport now?" "Confirm." After the voice fell, the emerald green light glowed from the center of the array. , spreading outward along the lines. The surrounding air began to tremble, and the light net pressed down from the top of his head, covering his entire body. The energy-devouring insect hovered outside the array, staring at the increasingly blurry figure in the light. The light suddenly became brighter. Ethan's figure twisted, folded, and disappeared in the light. The light ball at the top of the stone pillar dimmed again. The light also slowly dissipated. The energy-devouring insect hovered in the air, its six wings vibrating feebly. It stared at the center of the empty array, and the light in its compound eyes flickered. After a few seconds, it suddenly spoke. "Sister Ta Ling." A light green shadow appeared in the air, with its feet floating half a foot above the ground. There was a slight fluctuation in the sunlight. "Yes." "I want to find a student for the master." The energy-eating insect's voice became more serious, and the six legs were pulling gently under the body. The tower spirit's voice was still cold, "Huh?"
